standard_prerequisites.name: The Koszul complexes fit into distinguished triangles under multiplication of the exponents, by the More on Algebra Koszul multiplicativity lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers the Hom vanishing from the Koszul complex K to all its powers K_e.

standard_prerequisites.name: For an object supported on the closed complement of U, its cohomology classes on X are represented by maps from the powers of the Koszul complex, by the represent-cohomology-class lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the Hom vanishing into the vanishing of the cohomology of N, hence N = 0.

standard_prerequisites.name: An object of D_QCoh on an affine scheme is determined by the complex of modules of its global derived sections
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the vanishing of R Gamma with the vanishing of the object.

core_obligations: Form the cone triangle E -> Rj_*(E|_U) -> N -> E[1]; by adjunction Hom(K[n], Rj_*(E|_U)) = Hom(K|_U[n], E) = 0 for all n since K|_U = 0, so it suffices to prove the statement for N, i.e. we may assume E|_U = 0 (proof lines 4086-4096).
By the multiplicativity triangles of Koszul complexes, the vanishing of Hom(K[n], E) for all n implies the same for K replaced by every power K_e (proof lines 4097-4101).

Since E|_U = 0, the represent-cohomology-class lemma shows that the vanishing of Hom(K_e[n], E) for all e, n forces R Gamma(X, E) = 0; by the affine comparison E = 0, whence E = Rj_*(E|_U) holds trivially and the equivalence is established (proof lines 4101-4107).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the case E|_U = 0 via the cone triangle and adjunction (proof lines 4086-4096).
Extend the Hom vanishing to all Koszul powers via the multiplicativity triangles (proof lines 4097-4101).
Conclude E = 0 by the representation lemma and the affine comparison (proof lines 4101-4107).
